title: Eggless birthday cakes near Rouse Hill — ready before your Box Hill commute
summary:
Riverstone opens at 6am on weekdays. That's not early for us — it's for Box Hill and Vineyard parents who need a custom eggless birthday cake before the drive into Rouse Hill or the school run through Tallawong.

Every cake is 100% eggless — not some cakes, every cake. 15 flavours including Rasmalai and Mango, buttercream, fondant or ganache, any design you send through. Vegetarian and Jain families order without checking twice, because there's nothing to check.

48 hours minimum notice. That's what fresh baking actually takes. Free parking right at the shopping centre, so a 6am pickup from Shop 8 doesn't cost you the morning.

Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725.
